storageDialog.title: Storage
storageDialog.description: Cloud drive usage at a glance
storageDialog.capacityUnknown: This storage platform cannot report physical capacity (e.g. object storage); only usage is shown
storageDialog.capacityNote: How it is measured: total = writable space left on the storage backend + files already stored by GFS, so a very low usage right after setup is normal. Deleted files go to the recycle bin and only free space once emptied.
